property_summary: For any non-empty `_tos` array and any callee address, the reference C never reverts when the callee's low-level call succeeds (so transfer returns true); the mutant instead reverts on successful low-level calls — so there exist inputs (a helper callee that succeeds) that make the mutant revert while the reference succeeds.
change_summary: Invert the success check to revert when the low-level call succeeds, causing different state by aborting on success instead of on failure.
